actual_floor_audit.scope: One CLOSED clear lap. Recomputes known-route floor from frozen NPZ and PREVIOUS trace pose/speed; coordinator modification proof is separate from an overall tire-force guarantee.
actual_floor_audit.floor_scope_limitation: When the required floor dominates the baseline request, the release-only coordinator bypasses without escalating braking. The proven invariant concerns its shaped/released ticks, not every baseline brake tick or a measured physical friction bound.

numeric_margin_audit.scope: Independent metadata arithmetic check: mandatory profile floor equals independently audited envelope floor plus declaredmargin onlywhenpositive. Final shaped floor slack is audited separately.
